note.en: About 128% at S5. One of the early W-Engines whose bonus values double from S1 to S5, which makes it absurdly strong. Not only are its buffs higher, they are also easier to keep up.
About 103%. Alice's signature is the best limited W-Engine at S1. Its ATK% main stat can make it harder to reach her Anomaly Proficiency requirement compared with her own signature.

The reference option (100%). Her signature became much easier to use after her Potential Unlock: her Salchow Jump can trigger Perfect Dodges and her EX Specials count as Dash Attacks, so the Predatory Instinct stacks stay up more consistently.
About 90%. A decently strong option whose PEN Ratio main stat is not saturated by team buffs like ATK would be. It can be tricky to maintain, since the calculation assumes 2 stacks throughout.
About 89%. The best fully free-to-play A-rank option for many Anomaly agents. It grants a massive Anomaly Proficiency boost when any squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly.
